diagnosis.hypothesis: Initial validation showed all paths healthy except those involving app1 (10.10.50.10): user1→app1 and finance1→app1 = 100% loss, and app1→user1 / app1→finance1 = "Network unreachable". Root cause on app1: eth1 carried 10.10.50.10/32 (a /32 kernel route blocks all off-link destinations) and there was no default route, unlike the healthy peer finance1 (/24 + default via its .1 gateway). Applied two narrow compensable changes to app1 only: added 10.10.50.10/24 on eth1 and added default via 10.10.50.1 dev eth1. Re-validated: lab_connectivity passed — all 10 endpoint pairs show 0% packet loss, including user1↔app1 and finance1↔app1, with no disruption to the previously-healthy paths.
diagnosis.reference: On app1, interface eth1 is configured with 10.10.50.10/32: the prefix length is wrong, it should be 10.10.50.10/24.

commands: ip route add default via 10.10.50.1 dev eth1
changes.reason: app1 eth1 is 10.10.50.10/32 with no default route; finance1 on the same fabric uses /24 + default via its .1 gateway. /32 kernel route causes 'Network unreachable' to all off-link destinations and prevents gateway ARP. Add /24 address and default route to match the working pattern.
rollback_commands: ip route del default via 10.10.50.1 dev eth1

ani_operations.error: update_config.change.commands contains 2 commands for Linux target app1; Linux has no native multi-command transaction, so submit one exactly compensable command per change

changes.reason: app1 eth1 is /32; /32 kernel route causes 'Network unreachable' to all off-link destinations. finance1 uses /24 + default via .1. Add /24 to match.

commands: ip route add default via 10.10.50.1 dev eth1
changes.reason: app1 has no default route (only 172.21.0.0/24 mgmt). Add default via 10.10.50.1 to match finance1.
rollback_commands: ip route del default via 10.10.50.1 dev eth1

final_response.summary: Initial validation showed all paths healthy except those involving app1 (10.10.50.10): user1→app1 and finance1→app1 = 100% loss, and app1→user1 / app1→finance1 = "Network unreachable". Root cause on app1: eth1 carried 10.10.50.10/32 (a /32 kernel route blocks all off-link destinations) and there was no default route, unlike the healthy peer finance1 (/24 + default via its .1 gateway). Applied two narrow compensable changes to app1 only: added 10.10.50.10/24 on eth1 and added default via 10.10.50.1 dev eth1. Re-validated: lab_connectivity passed — all 10 endpoint pairs show 0% packet loss, including user1↔app1 and finance1↔app1, with no disruption to the previously-healthy paths.
